items.title: LEVEL 0 — THE ROAD to Q0 (incl. SP1 designer/evaluator role + the G3 threshold): incumbent frozen-time per-phase design AND per-phase evaluation of the decisive delta (O(St) corrector as the bar) vs the HYBRID (design per-phase, EVALUATE every competitor on the exact rotating-frame steady 3-D evaluator; bracket/ceiling screen first; tuned comparator)
items.question: Which road answers Q0 ('how does one optimize an RDE nozzle') most credibly at the least cost, given the MEASURED St_n (bell 0.35-0.60, plug up to 1.41 at the record head count; [X-STSC]) and the referee's five questions (external anchor, strongest opponent, uncertainty budget, reproducibility, generalization)? Is the incumbent CONFIRMED with new reasons as the CARRIER OF THE DECISIVE NUMBER, or is it the PILOT-arm / design-loop half of the hybrid tuple (the evaluator of the decisive delta being the wave-frame rung), or does an alternative DOMINATE under the pre-registered criterion (PROGRESS_2026-08-31_Sreview.md LOG-2)? Sub-question folded in (SP1 judge, FULL-PANEL scoped): must the representation rung be chosen SEPARATELY for the designer and the evaluator, and what is the G3 threshold ('St|J1| large', D6 :783, never derived)? USER QUESTION (11:16, binding for this item): 'if the decisive delta must be evaluated with a 3-D wave-frame solve anyway, what is the point of a per-phase adjoint?' — the parties must answer it with a COST FORK, not an opinion: the four trees priced the 3-D rotating-frame ADJOINT design road (d) at 10-20 sessions assuming a pseudo-time finite-volume solver, while the record claims B-lite = helical SPACE-MARCHING 'at marching cost' with the adjoint lifting by Lemma B ([S-BLITE] M0 :3027-3044) — a claim NEVER measured (C51 NEVER). If B-lite really costs O(K) per-phase family solves, designing DIRECTLY on the 3-D march (road (d) at marching cost) beats the hybrid and the per-phase adjoint is retired to oracle/initializer; if it costs an order of magnitude more (base pocket needs the pseudo-time sector solve; axial margin fails on the plug), the hybrid stands. State the measurement (one B-lite solve + Lemma-B adjoint on the record instance vs K per-phase family solves; the K that flips the road, derived from the loop's gradient count) and who runs it (F2.REPR C51 / F2.ENGINE first act). USER QUESTION 2 (11:19, binding): 'CFD with adjoint also means parametrizing the mesh and so on, right?' — the parties must price the THREE cost tiers explicitly: (1) HYBRID = per-phase engine with its existing AD adjoint for the search + a 3-D wave-frame evaluator used ADJOINT-FREE (values only, a few times: no volume-mesh parametrization, no mesh sensitivities dR/dX·dX/dalpha, no limiter differentiability issue); (2) road (d) via the record's B-lite helical SPACE-MARCHING = no volume mesh at all (the march generates its own grid from the data; the shape enters through the wall; adjoint by Lemma B on the x-block-triangular march) BUT the 3-D unit process (G12-L1-3D brick) is UNBUILT and the march is illegal where the axial margin fails (plug base pocket -> a pseudo-time sector solve WITH a mesh re-enters there); (3) road (d) via a 3-D finite-volume/DG solver with adjoint = mesh deformation (elasticity/RBF/regeneration) + mesh-sensitivity chain + adjoint consistency with mesh motion (discrete AD of the whole chain or continuous surface form) + non-differentiable shock capturing + free plume and base pocket inside the domain — the 10-20-session tier of the trees, and the 'adjoint in moving mesh' axis is NEVER adjudicated in the ledger (C31 alternatives lacked it; memory directive point 8). The agreed falsifier must include the COST measurement that separates tiers (2) and (3) from (1).
